subject: Vendr portal: API credentialing + evidence discovery for BrightWave
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@brightwave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding: API access + evidence scope for BrightWave

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — BrightWave is excited to proceed with the vendor profile in Vendr. To keep our procurement timeline, can you do two things this week:

1) Provision a service account/API credential we can use to validate SSO and automated evidence pulls (read-only).
2) Share a short list of the minimal evidence artifacts you can upload to Vendr in the next 72 hours (SOC 2 cert, data-flow diagram, retention policy).

I've attached our scoping matrix so you can map artifacts to our CAIQ requirements. If Vendr support needs to configure a connector, please loop them in.

Quick note on timeline: we need portal access and first-pass evidence by May 3 to hit our procurement committee date on May 10.

Appreciate it —
Claire
Security Programs Manager
BrightWave Analytics
[Attachment: brightwave_scoping_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@brightwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vendr Support <support@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: API access + evidence scope for BrightWave

Claire,

Thanks — good to hear BrightWave wants to move quickly. We're ready to help. Short answers up front:

- We can provision a read-only service account scoped to the Vendr connector by EOD tomorrow.
- Immediate artifacts we can push: SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted), system architecture diagram (PDF), data retention policy (PDF), and our CAIQ mapping CSV.

I'll coordinate the credential handoff with Marcus (infra) and Ben (security) — Marcus will generate the keypair and Ben will confirm the scope. Vendr support: can you confirm the steps you require to wire our API credential into your connector and whether any cert pinning or IP allowlists are needed?

Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendr_scoping_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vendr Support <support@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: API access + evidence scope for BrightWave

Team,

I created a service account at 12:40pm PT in our secrets manager (svc-vendr-brightwave) and generated a key for Vendr's connector. Key details:
- Principle: svc-vendr-brightwave@redwood-inference.svc
- Scope: read-only to object metadata and evidence manifest; no access to raw customer blobs or keys.
- Rotation: 90 days; manual rotation scheduled.

Ben: can you review the attached policy draft and confirm it meets our least-privilege bar? Also confirming we'll provide the credential as a one-time encrypted string via the Vendr portal secret field.

Attachments: svc-account-policy.pdf

- Marcus

From: Vendr Support <support@vendrsecurity.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Claire Nguyen <claire@brightwave.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: API access + evidence scope for BrightWave

Hi all,

Thanks for the details. Quick checklist for the connector:
1) We accept an HMAC-style API token via the profile 'Secrets' field; no IP allowlist required but we recommend an allowlist for extra security.
2) We do not require cert pinning for API tokens; for mutual TLS we support it as an opt-in.
3) When you upload the credential, mark it as 'Read-only' and attach the service-account-policy.pdf for our audit trail.

Once you add the secret to the Vendr profile, our system will attempt a validation pull. If it succeeds we'll ingest the following artifacts automatically: SOC 2 metadata, CAIQ mapping CSV, system diagram (PDF). If any artifacts need manual attachment, we'll send a follow-up.

Portal link: https://app.vendr.io/profile/redwood-inference

Regards,
Vendr Support
[Portal ticket: VENDR-2297]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Claire Nguyen <claire@brightwave.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendrsecurity.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: API access + evidence scope for BrightWave

Claire — Soojin — Vendr team,

I reviewed the svc-account-policy.pdf and confirmed the scope is appropriate for a read-only connector. A couple of operational notes:

- We'll upload the credential into Vendr now and flag it as read-only.
- I'll also attach a redacted SOC 2 cover letter and our CAIQ mapping CSV to the portal. Expect the validation pull to run within the hour; I'll update this thread when it's green.

Soojin: after the pull, let's run the CAIQ diff against BrightWave's matrix to call out any missing artifacts they still need. Marcus: can you stand by for a quick follow-up to rotate the key if Vendr asks for a test rotate?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
